doc.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009

title: Newport 1958 with Goodman, Konitz, Monk, Rollins, Scott
summary: Grimes recounts playing with several leaders in one weekend at Newport.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Henry I wanted to ask you about something I read and first I thought it was like this has to be a misprint or something, but, in 1960 you did the Newport Jazz Festival?
’58. And you played with about four different bands then? Benny Goodman and Lee Konitz, Thelonious Monk.
Sonny Rollins and who else, somebody else.
Tony Scott. That was a heck of a weekend.

Boy I don’t know, I used to wonder about that myself, it’s like I ran into this luck, which I wanted to do. I wanted to do some playing, and there I was playing with guys I used to know on records. And that was just a fantastic thing.
